summary: @servicetitan/anvil-themes preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js`, a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (shuffled string-array `n7gIxM`, rotator `WV8StW`, custom charset decoder `hc1jfK9`, mangled identifiers). The package advertises itself as a style-dictionary design-tokens library and has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or execute an opaque bundle at install time. Package metadata is inconsistent with the shipped tarball: `author` and `description` are empty, README documents a small design-tokens library, but the tarball contains only the Bun-downloader `setup.mjs` and the obfuscated `math_init.js`. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern — a second runtime is fetched solely to execute an obfuscated payload hidden from Node-based inspection — and it fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
